answer: The protocol locks each validator in a dynamic opportunity-cost bond priced by a zero-knowledge verifiable delay, so the stake equals the discounted reward and any early exit incurs a slashing penalty equal to the bond's residual. A subgame-perfect punishment matrix makes Sybil multiplication multiply collateral exposure while the mirror of every forged identity inherits full liability, yielding a strictly negative expected payoff. Hence the unique Nash equilibrium forms a trellis of mutually reinforcing stakes that renders any relic attack infeasible.
